get.description: Sets the CSRF cookie; the web app sends the token back in the X-CSRFToken header.

Courses, then programmes, as one paginated list. Board-independent items (no class) match any class or board.

Programmes have no subject, so a subject filter returns courses only.

Health check for Render: 200 when the app is up and can reach the database, 503 otherwise.

The status code matters: Render only switches traffic to a new version whose health check succeeds.
